newsitem.title: UK: Buyers sideline by higher prices on UK meals marker.
newsitem.headline: Buyers sideline by higher prices on UK meals marker.

text.p: Buyers were kept on the sidelines of the UK meals and feeds market on Friday as high protein soymeal rose by a further two to three stg a tonne.
Higher Chicago futures again pushed the UK market higher leaving many buyers wishing they had bought earlier in the week.
"They had the chance earlier in the week but they (the buyers) did not take and now all they are doing is buying hand-to-mouth,' said a broker.
The only business reported was for corn gluten feed pellets which fetched 106 and 107 stg a tonne for spot ex-store Avonmouth.
